name: get_rolling_release_billing_status
description:
Get the Rolling Releases billing status for a project. The team level billing status is used to determine if the project can be configured for rolling releases.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/billing --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
